summary: The occlusion lifetime repair passes the native simulator review. First-entry locate/card clearance and More center taps work on iPhone 17 and iPhone 18 Pro. Optimized Release runtime evidence proves pressed, busy, restored and live Reduce Motion states, source Dialog access and native More return, Dynamic Type refit, and route teardown. No product blockers remain in the reviewed scope.

sourceManifest.scope: Reviewed source, tests, specs and authored preview artifacts. Authored previews are preserved context, not native runtime proof.

notes: Measurement subscription cleanup no longer clears renderer-owned native occlusion when readiness, position, detent or callback dependencies change.
Modal presentation, genuine host teardown and unmount release occlusion. Acknowledged native removal transfers measurement ownership to the DOM fallback.
Generation cleanup retains the current snapshot; stale native work cannot clear a newer geometry snapshot.
Loaded-style licensing remains complete in the existing Dialog. Current-result and retained-selection notices remain available there; standalone App/native attribution is absent.
Native UIKit controls use public SDK APIs. Native bottom navigation retains its baseline. No backend API, provider, HTTP contract or dependency edits were made by this reviewer.

sourceReview.staticResults: Writer lint, typecheck, check:rules and focused Prettier checks passed. These receipts were verified and reused.
sourceReview.priorResults: The original 86 focused tests and seven browser regressions remain prior evidence for unchanged behavior. They were not rerun or presented as fresh native provenance.

pressBusyAndRestoration.pressObservation: Recorded long press changes the refresh glyph footprint from 45x44 pixels to 42x42; stable runtime control bounds remain 44x48pt. The released idle glyph returns in the same full-screen recording.
pressBusyAndRestoration.activityObservation: Busy video samples at 50.00/50.13/50.27/50.40 seconds show successive spinner phases. Reduced samples at 385.00/385.13/385.27/385.40 seconds are pixel-identical static busy glyphs. Restored samples at 523 seconds show the idle refresh glyph.

liveReduceMotion.observation: Setting changed while requests stayed held and the app session remained alive. Reduce Motion=1 removed the activity view and kept the disabled button and busy accessibility value. Returning to 0 restored an animating indicator while still busy. Button identity and bounds did not change.

nativeMoreReturn.observation: A conditional public UIKit breakpoint captured the actual layout-change notification targeting the native More button after Dialog closure. Native More was actionable, selection remained, and no keyboard reopened. The debugger detached cleanly.
nativeMoreReturn.limit: This proves the native notification target and usable return control. VoiceOver speech and screen-reader focus behavior were not measured.

dynamicTypeAndLocate.observation: Live type changes refit the existing native card and readable controls. Selected Native Hall remains. A native hierarchy center tap on locate completed without opening More, losing selection or reopening the keyboard.
dynamicTypeAndLocate.finalInput: UITextField text=Shanghai, firstResponder=0, markedText=0, hidden=1, fontSize=17, Reduce Motion=0 after restoration.
dynamicTypeAndLocate.locationPermission: Public CoreLocation authorizationStatus remained 3 before and after the locate tap; no permission setting changed. Successful GPS coordinates are not an acceptance claim.

readinessAndTeardown.observation: Leaving Map removes both native search card and locate. Re-entering presents a usable native card; source Dialog presentation removes native card and keyboard, and closure restores native controls. Writer tests cover acknowledgment and generation lifetime edge cases.

retainedInfrastructureFindings: occlusion-search-source stopped at Maestro's absolute screenshot-path containment check after its result assertions passed. A separate continuation selected the existing result and completed the Dialog checks; the failed receipt remains.
The first Settings text-row tap did not toggle Reduce Motion. Only the later actual switch hit, defaults value and UIKit receipts prove the live setting change. Earlier files remain.

The first focus-notification probe had an Objective-C type-expression error and is not focus evidence. The separately retained typed UIKit probe captured the intended native target and detached cleanly.

The initial large-text helper's exterior point (201,306) hit Clear: native bounds [8,302][378,382]. Its later First-source assertion therefore had an invalid selected-source precondition. Size-only validation retained selection; the measured exterior point (20,87) preserved it. Failure, menu screenshot/hierarchy and pre-change movie frame remain.
The decimal-percent locate attempt failed in Maestro's parser before a tap. A separate native hierarchy center tap passed; the parser failure remains.

The old hierarchy helper ignored its third UDID argument. occlusion-18pro-first-hierarchy is an iPhone 17 capture and is not 18 Pro evidence. occlusion-18pro-owned-hierarchy has the correct explicit 18 Pro UDID and exit 0.

residualRisks: Runtime proof covers iOS 27 portrait simulators on iPhone 17 and owned iPhone 18 Pro with deterministic contract-validated fixture data. It does not establish physical-device, iOS 26, 17 Pro profile or production-provider behavior.
VoiceOver speech/focus traversal and real Pinyin marked-text composition were not measured. The UIKit notification target and Latin query/keyboard behavior are proved.
Original geometry-versus-capability IPC ordering was not instrumented. The source hypothesis is supported by the lifetime regression and corrected first-entry behavior.
Unsupported bridge and late-ack failure paths rely on inspected code and focused tests; native runtime failure injection was not performed.
The retained simulator package uses owned loopback fixture origins. Those services are stopped; this package is review evidence and was not delivered to a phone.
diffSummary: Writer's reviewed native occlusion/source correction preserved. This reviewer added only private review scripts and evidence under /tmp, wrote this report, and cleaned verified wrapper-generated icons. Repository source, task artifacts and authored previews retain their reviewed bytes.
manualNotes: I inspected fresh native full-screen screenshots and actual video-derived press/loading/restoration frames, read the source repair and receipts, measured native hierarchy clearance, and captured public UIKit state on the optimized process. More is reachable on first entry; source Dialog access/return and Dynamic Type clearance pass. Prior rework evidence remains unchanged. Tooling and gesture mistakes remain recorded and are not counted as product failures or hidden retries. No phone or publication action occurred.
